text: 🚨🎙️| Deco: “Signing a CB in January? Everything is possible. It's true that injuries have COMPLICATED things, and of course we have to analyze, sit down with the manager, and decide. To go in January, we have to know very well what we're looking for.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Bojan Krkic: “Signing a striker? Hansi Flick and his coaching staff felt that Raphinha had more freedom on the wing, but also had the ability to play as a 9. He’s proving to all of us that he can be a genuine No. 9, even against low blocks, which was one of the doubts. He’s performing at a very high level, so naturally, we're NOT thinking about signing a traditional striker for now.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Deco on Frenkie de Jong: “Was there tension between club and Frenkie about his injury? NO, there was no misunderstanding. He was having problems, which is understandable, and he decided against surgery. Everything has gone well. The decision was made in consultation with the medical department. The club doesn't impose its opinion on anyone; this is about the player's health.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Deco: “International football is always a difficult subject. Every year, new tournaments keep appearing. At least with the Nations League, teams remain in Europe. But someone needs to explain to me why Brazil have to play friendlies in Singapore and Japan mid season!” #fcblive 🇧🇷

🚨🎙️| Yves Bissouma (Ajax): “I really LIKE Frenkie de Jong as a player. I faced him only once, in a pre-season friendly between Tottenham and Barcelona around three years ago, and we immediately clicked after the game. I LOVE watching him play. He’s an excellent, intelligent player who makes everything look effortless. I think we see football in the same way. Of course, we’re not exactly the same player. He has qualities I don’t, and vice versa, but our understanding of football is very similar.” #fcblive ⭐

🚨| 𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆: A HEATED confrontation reportedly took place inside Barcelona's boardroom during the Atlético Madrid match.

Before kick-off, Mateu Alemany approached several Barça board members with whom he had previously worked and greeted them. At half-time, Alejandro Echevarría confronted those directors for greeting Alemany, given the strained relationship between him and the club. Several board members objected, explaining that Alemany had simply approached them to say hello. Enric Masip stepped in to defend the directors, insisting that it was nothing more than a simple greeting. The argument continued to escalate until Joan Laporta had to raise his voice to put an end to it.

Some board members are reportedly still deeply resentful towards Echevarría over the way he has treated them repeatedly. [@esport3] #fcblive 💥

🚨🗣️ Xavier Bosch (@mundodeportivo): “Deco and the club’s plan for the summer was to keep Ronald Araújo, sign Alessandro Bastoni on a five-year agreement that was already in place, and move on from Andreas Christensen.

However, Flick preferred to continue relying on Gerard Martín, renew Christensen’s contract and avoid signing a new CB, opting instead to strengthen the attacking options. The club ultimately backed Flick’s vision.

So, if Bastoni wasn’t convincing enough for Flick in the summer, what makes people think he would convince him in January? Flick clearly sees him as too slow for a high defensive line, and he certainly won’t suddenly become Usain Bolt in January.” #fcblive
